messages.body: minfix plan conflict: SPEC section 4 applies the one-line substitution s#/sc:spec-panel @#/sc:spec-panel-minfix @# to review briefs T05, T07 AND T09 (T09 = the S1 review-3 brief). Your owner decision says the S1 review-3 brief stays unchanged. Without the substitution, review 3 runs plain /sc:spec-panel, so it never runs fixcheck on cycle 2 and cannot mark over-budget or escalated fixes as open. Recommended: A = apply the command-name substitution to T09 too, leaving every other word of T09 (including 'any finding of any severity is FAIL') untouched. B = T09 fully verbatim; review 3 runs the 427 command and the plan drops the cycle-2 fixcheck re-check. Which?
